The '''Eva-T system''' was located within the [[Quence sector/Legends|Quence sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was in this [[Star system/Legends|star system]] where [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] was promoted to the rank of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]]. It was also here that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] negotiated a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] scientist's release from [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
